Summary: Epic 1: WIP Draft Upload & Watermark Protection
Description:
Accept versioned work-in-progress drafts from the Digital Artist against an open milestone, and guarantee that the Client Buyer only ever sees a watermarked derivative while the original stays unreachable until payment.

Traces to: FR-001, FR-003, FR-004 / UC-03, UC-04, UC-05

Summary: Story 1.1: Upload a versioned WIP draft
Description:
As a digital artist,
I want to upload a WIP draft against an open milestone with a version note,
So that the buyer can follow progress and no earlier version is lost.

Acceptance criteria: Two uploads produce two distinct timestamped versions under the milestone; no version is overwritten and an unassigned artist cannot upload.
Traces to: FR-003 / UC-03

Summary: Story 1.2: Apply a diagonal watermark to every draft
Description:
As a client buyer,
I want every draft I view to carry a diagonal watermark with the commission ID and my buyer identifier,
So that unfinished artwork cannot be lifted and reused before it is paid for.

Acceptance criteria: For 20 test images the portal renders only a watermarked preview carrying both identifiers; no preview lacks the overlay.
Traces to: FR-001 / UC-04

Summary: Story 1.3: Notify the buyer when a draft is ready
Description:
As a client buyer,
I want to be notified when a new watermarked draft is published,
So that I review it promptly instead of checking the portal on the off chance.

Acceptance criteria: The notification fires only after the watermarked preview is published, and never for a version that failed processing.
Traces to: FR-004 / UC-05

Summary: Story 1.4: Keep originals in private storage
Description:
As a digital artist,
I want my original upload kept in private storage with no buyer-facing link,
So that the unwatermarked file is never reachable before payment.

Acceptance criteria: A direct request for the original by the buyer returns 403 with no file data; a storage scan finds no public link to an original.
Traces to: FR-001 / UC-03

Summary: Story 1.5: Fail closed if watermarking fails
Description:
As a digital artist,
I want the system to withhold the preview and flag the version when watermarking fails,
So that a processing error never leaks an unprotected draft to the buyer.

Acceptance criteria: A forced watermark failure marks the version Processing Failed, removes buyer-facing access, notifies only the artist, and exposes no unwatermarked asset.
Traces to: FR-001 / UC-04

As a client buyer,
I want to open the latest watermarked draft for a milestone,
So that I can judge progress before approving or asking for changes.

Acceptance criteria: Only the commission owner can open the draft; the version number and submission timestamp are shown alongside it.
Traces to: FR-004 / UC-05
